title: The Mike Ditka Memorial Game
description: The Chicago Bears hosted New England in their first home game following the October 9 death of legendary coach and player Mike Ditka. Soldier Field honored Ditka with a pregame tribute, commemorative field markings, No. 89 jersey patches, and fan activities. The opponent was New England, whom Ditka's Bears defeated 46-10 in Super Bowl XX. Research category: organizational loss / memorial game.
